description: Edwards pump-station speed curves used as simulator defaults. Units: [Torr, L/s]. Sources are cited by name only (no links) by project policy.
station_rule: S(P) = max(turbo*k, scroll); k = user turbo plateau / 84; log-log interpolation, end-clamped

scroll_nXDS10iC.anchor_source: Edwards nXDS10i catalog specifications (nXDS brochure 3601-0088-01 and vendor listings for the nXDS10iC corrosion-resistant build)
scroll_nXDS10iC.shape_source: digitized typical characteristic between catalog anchors (approximate)
scroll_nXDS10iC.note: nXDS10iC is the SCROLL (roughing) pump - the 'C' is the corrosion-resistant variant, not a turbo

turbo_nEXT85_DN63.shape_source: digitized typical characteristic between catalog anchors (approximate)
